srs: The energy metering system records Resident, Reading, MeteringService, and Meter; each has an id attribute. Each Resident can have zero or more Reading records, and each Reading belongs to exactly one Resident. Each Reading uses exactly one MeteringService, and each MeteringService serves zero or more Reading records. Each MeteringService manages one or more Meter records by composition, and each Meter belongs to exactly one MeteringService. Each Resident can reference zero or more Meter records, and each Meter can be referenced by zero or more Resident records.
